recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for the core reconcile run. issue_request: FHIR-37772 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against R4B after Implementation Guides showed resource.id as datatype string rather than id, with US Core AllergyIntolerance cited as the example. The Jira resolution says Grahame would include a fix in IG Publisher.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir core commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37772. The current Resource.id definition already uses the structuredefinition-fhir-type extension with valueUrl id while retaining the underlying FHIRPath System.String code. Git history shows the current line had id as the FHIR type marker before the Jira was raised, and commit 73080e5bdeff04df26787237e1412af2fc181915 later corrected the extension value element from valueUri to valueUrl.
additional_context: FHIR-28121, an earlier US Core report of the same resource.id string/id mismatch, was Resolved - No Change because the id element is defined by IG Publisher and not by US Core profiles. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-08-01 list FHIR-37772 as a technical correction. The current published US Core AllergyIntolerance definitions page renders AllergyIntolerance.id with Type id.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source change was made. The authoritative core source is in current build scope and already carries the FHIR datatype id marker; the accepted fix target and related Jira evidence place the display issue in IG Publisher or generated IG publication artifacts.
